settings_low_quality:
📊 Low Compression Quality
• Strongest size reduction
• More visible image loss
• Best for sharing drafts
settings_medium_quality:
📊 Medium Compression Quality
• Balanced reduction
• Moderate quality retention
• Good default for most PDFs
settings_high_quality:
📊 High Compression Quality
• Lighter compression
• Better visual retention
• File size reduction is less predictable
settings_very_high_quality:
📊 Very High Compression Quality
• Minimal compression
• Strong visual preservation
• Good when quality matters most
settings_ultra_quality:
📊 Ultra Compression Quality (Pro)
• Lightest compression available
• Maximum visual preservation
• Typically the largest output among presets
